facts.business: Ind Bank Housing Limited was a housing finance company whose NHB licence was cancelled by RBI on 21.09.2023 and the Board has given in-principle approval for winding up of the company.

auditor.name: M/s. A.R.Krishnan & Associates, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The Company incurred a net loss of Rs.8,83,208 during the year ended March 31, 2026 and events/conditions indicate a material uncertainty exists that may cast significant doubt on the Company's ability to continue as a going concern. Key Audit Matter: RBI cancelled the NHB licence w.e.f 21.09.2023 and the Board gave in-principle approval for winding up of the company under section 271 of the Companies Act 2013 subject to Shareholders and Other Regulatory approvals.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to net loss and cancellation of NHB licence
Winding up proceedings under section 271 of Companies Act 2013 pending shareholder and regulatory approvals
